spans.s:
च — च may be used to express immediate
[]
connection between two acts or their simultaneous
occurrence (e. g. मम च मुक्तं तमसा
मनो मनसिजेन धनुषि शरश्च निवेशितः,
no sooner is my mind freed from darkness than a
shaft is fixed on his bow by the heart-born god).

चचेण्डा चचेण्डा, f., N. of a fruit-bearing
creeper, = बृहत्-फल, वेश्म-कूल, श्वेत-राजी,
commonly चिचिडा.

चच्चपुट चच्चपुट or (according to another
authority) चच्चत्पुट, अस्, m. a kind of time in
music.

चाचपुट चाचपुट, अस्, m. a kind of time in
music; [cf. चच्चपुट.]

चाचलि चाचलि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. Intens. of rt. चल्),
moving much or repeatedly; [cf. वि-चाचलि and अ-विच्˚.]
